chunks: And when Abraham was raising the plinth of the House with Ishmael, (he prayed): "Accept this from us, O Lord, for You hear and know everything;"
ai.seo_question: What was the prayer of Ibrahim and Ismail when building the Kaaba?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this verse marks the establishment of the Kaaba as the first house of worship, with Ibrahim and Ismail acting as the primary architects under divine command. Their supplication emphasizes the acceptance of righteous deeds, a concept central to Shia jurisprudence regarding the validity of worship (ibadat) and the spiritual significance of the Kaaba as the qibla for the entire Muslim ummah.
